title: Iran ‘prefers diplomacy’ but if there’s a war, Tehran says it’s ready
summary: Iran and the US traded threats as President Donald Trump warned of renewed strikes a day after he said he held off a major assault in hopes of a peace deal. Reporting from Tehran, FRANCE 24’s Reza Sayah says Iranian officials have maintained their position that “they prefer diplomacy.
